tool_args.rationale: The monotone, concave pilot spans a substantial sink-gradient range and reaches the archived gray zone above 2.36. A high-gradient probe can distinguish a smooth siphon from a supercritical avalanche before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth inland-hub siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, so it cannot rule out the archived avalanche threshold just above the observed range.
The pilot signatures point to a sink-gradient mechanism; the high-gradient probe directly tests the unresolved threshold at lower cost.
It does not discriminate the relevant mechanisms.
